scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "uv run -m uvicorn accountable.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --reload --reload-dir backend/accountable" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.format: npm run format -w frontend && uv run -m ruff format backend
scripts.format:check: npm run format:check -w frontend && uv run -m ruff format --check backend
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w frontend && uv run -m ty check backend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w frontend && uv run -m ruff check backend
scripts.check:static: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run secrets
scripts.check:quick: npm run check:static && npm run test:backend && npm run test:unit
